articles.summary: KING OF PRUSSIA, Pa. , June 11, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Universal Health Realty Income Trust (NYSE:UHT) announced today that its Board of Trustees voted to increase the quarterly dividend by $.005 and pay a dividend of $.74 per share on June 30, 2025 to shareholders of record as of June 23, 2025 .
articles.title: UNIVERSAL HEALTH REALTY INCOME TRUST ANNOUNCES DIVIDEND INCREASE
